response.sql: WITH site_avg AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS avg_faces FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat HAVING AVG(m.facetfaces) IS NOT NULL), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_faces) AS b FROM site_avg), status_avg AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_faces) AS sa FROM site_avg WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat), kept AS (SELECT a.avg_faces, a.avg_faces - bl.b AS over_base, a.avg_faces - st.sa AS over_status FROM site_avg a CROSS JOIN baseline bl JOIN status_avg st ON st.entrystat = a.entrystat WHERE bl.b IS NOT NULL AND a.avg_faces > st.sa) SELECT AVG(avg_faces) AS avg_kept_face_avg, AVG(over_base) AS avg_excess_over_baseline, AVG(over_status) AS avg_excess_over_status_avg FROM kept

assumptions.assumption: Only sites with at least one scanmesh record and at least one non-null facetfaces value form the per-site set; sites without usable mesh data are excluded from the baseline and status averages.
If no kept sites exist (including no baseline), the query still returns one row with NULLs.
